text: Versioned .bowman migrations: dataModelVersion, ordered idempotent migrations, read-only guard for newer data
description: meta.json dataModelVersion (now 3) is the storage version. shared/bowman-migration runs registered migrations above it in order under a .migration-lock shared by backend, loop worker and agent tools; migrations may declare a pending check because legacy data can return through git. Projects from a newer Aimparency open read-only (writes refused). Migration 2 = ordered phase tree (still derived lazily), 3 = aims→ideas. Frozen fixtures data-model-v1/v2, npm run verify:migration <repo> dry-runs on a copy and compares the graph. How to add one: AGENTS.md "Data Model Changes".

status.comment: Merged to main (d7ffc5f, 1ec7cd8); this repo recorded v3 (d855ef3). Verified: shared 47 tests incl. 8 runner tests (order, idempotence, 5 concurrent openers apply once, legacy files after upgrade, newer project read-only, failure stops at last good version, stale lock), backend 35 tests incl. read-only API test, verify:migration unchanged on fixtures v1/v2 and on the pre-migration snapshot of this repo. Awaiting Felix acceptance.
